armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), GAMBLER (Your SOAK has very high variance and can go into NEGATIVE values, (Increase damage taken when NEGATIVE))
armor.desc: A reckless, grinning field for adepts who find safety boring. It leans toward the occult, fending off hexes and spirits, but how much it fends off on any given strike is anyone's guess — it might shrug off a killing blow or fold like wet paper and let it land worse than it should. The variance is the point; the veil treats every wound as a coin-flip and occasionally bets against you. It does firm up as its bearer's spirit stirs, sharper still at full focus, but never reliably. Rare, pricey, and quietly disreputable. Sold with a wink and absolutely no warranty.

armor.name: Intermediate Gambling Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), GAMBLER (Your SOAK has very high variance and can go into NEGATIVE values, (Increase damage taken when NEGATIVE))
armor.desc: This developed ward does not believe in moderation. Some blows it swallows whole, the field flaring to a wall that nothing seems able to touch; others it shrugs off so badly that the wearer takes the hit harder than if they'd worn nothing at all. The swing is enormous and entirely sincere — a veil that can drink down more than almost anything in its class, or fold inward and make you wish it hadn't. It thickens as the keeper's spirit gathers and thickens at the height of their focus, though even peak focus won't teach it manners. The table-haunters of Berilia adore it precisely because it might betray them. The house always wins. This ward simply asks: are you the house today?

armor.name: Major Gambling Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), GAMBLER (Your SOAK has very high variance and can go into NEGATIVE values, (Increase damage taken when NEGATIVE))
armor.desc: The honest mystics call this one madness; the rest call it the best wager in Alliance Space. Its protection swings wildly from one blow to the next — sometimes a wall so high nothing recorded has breached it, sometimes a gap so wide the strike lands harder than it should, the field briefly working against the very flesh it guards. Most days the odds run gloriously in your favor; some days the bones come up empty and you bleed for it. Every other guard climbs as the spirit wakes, soaring to ludicrous heights at the crest of power. They built one and never dared build another, which is, fittingly, the gamblers' kind of legend.

armor.name: Minor Overmind Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), SPIRITPROOF (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against SPIRITUAL attacks.)
armor.desc: A specialist's veil that turns its full attention to the unseen and lets everything else fend for itself. Against curses, possessing spirits, and occult assault it always holds at its very firmest — a flat, certain wall where most wards merely hope. Against blade, beam, and intrusion it is unremarkable, frankly a little distracted. The field grows stronger as its bearer's spirit stirs, stronger still at the height of their focus. Common gear among exorcists and ghost-walkers who know exactly what is hunting them and refuse to leave that one door unlocked. Everything physical can wait; the dead cannot be reasoned with.

armor.name: Intermediate Overmind Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), SPIRITPROOF (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against SPIRITUAL attacks.)
armor.desc: Against the occult — possessing whispers, hexes, the cold fingers of hostile spirits — this seasoned ward gives its absolute fullness, every time, without a flicker of doubt. It is a mind walled in mirrored silence; intrusions arrive, see only their own reflection, and leave. The broader veil is steady and unspectacular, but where the unseen is concerned it is a closed door with no handle on the outside. It firms as its bearer's spirit rises and firms again at the crest of their focus, deepening an already deep refusal. The old adepts of Berilia favor it for hauntings that bite back. Nothing gets into this head uninvited, which, given the head, is a mercy for everyone.

armor.name: Major Overmind Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), SPIRITPROOF (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against SPIRITUAL attacks.)
armor.desc: Built to slam the door on everything that knocks from the other side of the veil. Against ghost, hex, possession, and the cold reach of the dead, this ward never falters and never rolls poorly — it simply holds at its absolute best, every time, as a matter of settled law. Its shielding against the merely physical is modest, but the occult cannot find purchase on it at all. As the bearer's spirit wakes the certainty spreads outward to every guard, becoming, at full power, a mind too large for any intruder to fit inside. Exorcists in Berilia speak of it the way drowning sailors speak of dry land.

armor.name: Minor Latency Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), DISCRETE (You hardly register on electronic surveillance. You now always have passive concealment of 5 vs AI and Electronics.)
armor.desc: A hush woven into the spirit, made to slip the notice of every watching machine. It blunts intrusion and tech-strikes reasonably well and turns aside blade and beam a little, but its quiet talent is invisibility: cameras lose interest, sensors find only smudges, and prowling AI keeps misfiling you as nobody worth tracking. The veil also firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Rare and costly, popular with those who must move through surveilled streets without leaving a single clean frame behind. It won't stop a bullet so much as ensure the gun never quite knew you were there.

armor.name: Intermediate Latency Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), DISCRETE (You hardly register on electronic surveillance. You now always have passive concealment of 5 vs AI and Electronics.)
armor.desc: Cameras find a smear where the wearer should be; tracking AIs log a glitch and move on. This developed ward bends the bearer's signature into background noise, so machines and electronics quietly fail to care that a person is standing right there. The protective field itself is sharp against tech intrusion, a confident veil for someone who treats surveillance as the real weapon. It firms as the keeper's spirit gathers and firms further at the peak of their focus. The dampening is reliable enough that ghosting past a sensor grid becomes routine rather than reckless. It cannot hide you from a person with working eyes. The machines, though, will swear you were never on the manifest.

armor.name: Major Latency Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), DISCRETE (You hardly register on electronic surveillance. You now always have passive concealment of 5 vs AI and Electronics.)
armor.desc: The masterwork of mystics who decided the safest thing to be is unobserved. This veil leans hardest against intrusion through the wires, holding the digital at bay with deep and patient strength, but its true marvel is how thoroughly it erases its wearer from the machine-world's gaze. Cameras find a smear, sensors find a rumor, hunting drones quietly conclude the room is empty. As the bearer's spirit stirs every guard lifts with it, climbing remarkably high at full power. One of a kind, and the records say nothing of who made it, which is, of course, exactly what you'd want them to say.

armor.name: Minor Blinking Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.)
armor.desc: A flickering, half-here field for adepts learning to be in two moments at once. It guards tolerably against intrusion and tech, and a little against blade and beam, but mostly it just stutters the wearer in and out of the instant, hard to fix and harder to hit cleanly. There is nothing exotic in its property beyond that restless shimmer, but it reads as a person seen through a dropped signal. The veil sharpens as its bearer's spirit stirs, sharper still at full focus. Uncommon, mid-priced, and faintly disorienting to stand near. Onlookers report a headache; the wearer reports being elsewhere.

armor.name: Intermediate Blinking Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.)
armor.desc: The wearer flickers — here, then a finger-width to the side, then here again — and the strike meant for them tastes only the after-image. This seasoned ward leans into tech-defeating reflexes, the field stuttering the bearer through tiny stolen instants whenever harm draws near. The veil it raises is light but quick, trading raw bulk for the maddening habit of simply not being where the blow expected. It firms as its bearer's spirit rises and firms again at the height of their focus, the blinks growing crisper and harder to predict. There is a flashier consumer knockoff of the trick that mostly just gives you a headache; this older working actually moves you. Aim where they were; they weren't.

armor.name: Major Blinking Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.)
armor.desc: It barely seems to shield at all — and that is the joke its makers are still laughing at. Most blows that would land find that the bearer was, for the merest stutter of an instant, simply somewhere else, the field winking them a hair out of the line of fire. Against the wires it holds a respectable, steady ward, but its thin skin against everything else is almost an insult until you notice nothing ever quite connects. As the bearer's spirit wakes every guard rises, and at full power the wearer becomes a frustrating little flicker the universe keeps failing to hit. The kind of relic that makes assassins take up gentler work.

armor.name: Minor Quickness Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), SPEED (While using this DEFENSE to SOAK attacks that target SPEED defense you add your SPEED result as guaranteed additionnal SOAK)
armor.desc: A ward tuned to reflex rather than resilience, for the kind of mystic who survives by being somewhere else when the blow arrives. It blunts intrusion and tech well enough and dulls blade and beam a touch, but it shines when something tries to outpace you: the faster your own footwork, the more of that speed it folds directly into turning the strike aside. The veil also firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Common gear for duelists and couriers who treat standing still as a character flaw. Slow down and it's merely adequate; keep moving and it keeps faith.

armor.name: Intermediate Quickness Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), SPEED (While using this DEFENSE to SOAK attacks that target SPEED defense you add your SPEED result as guaranteed additionnal SOAK)
armor.desc: When something fast comes for the wearer, this developed ward answers in kind, folding their own swiftness straight into the wall as guaranteed extra refusal — the quicker the keeper, the more the strike finds nothing but a closing door. Against threats aimed at reflex and reaction it is a confident, agile veil, sharp toward tech intrusion and built for people who win by moving first. It firms as the spirit gathers and firms again at the peak of focus. The bargain is plain: stand still and it is merely good; move like you mean it and it becomes formidable. Slow mystics may apply. They will simply enjoy it less.

armor.name: Major Quickness Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), SPEED (While using this DEFENSE to SOAK attacks that target SPEED defense you add your SPEED result as guaranteed additionnal SOAK)
armor.desc: Speed is its own armor, and this ward knows the secret in its bones. When something arrives aimed at the bearer's reflexes — the trap that springs, the strike that demands you be elsewhere — the field folds their own swiftness directly into the shielding, every step of quickness becoming guaranteed protection rather than a gamble. It holds firmly against intrusion through the wires and lifts every guard as the spirit wakes, soaring at the height of power. The faster you are, the less anything touches you; the truly fast become a rumor of motion with a wall wrapped around it. A masterwork prized by couriers, duelists, and anyone with somewhere urgent to not-be.

armor.name: Minor Penetration Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), INDESTRUCTIBLE (This defense cannot be BREACHED.)
armor.desc: A stubborn little field that may not turn aside much, but absolutely will not break. It guards modestly against intrusion and only lightly against blade and beam, yet no amount of focused punishment will shatter or collapse it — there is no crack to widen, no seam to exploit. Where flashier wards fail catastrophically, this one simply endures, dull and unimpressed. The veil firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Common, cheap, and reassuringly boring. The kind of working you buy precisely because you expect someone to spend real effort trying to ruin it.

armor.name: Intermediate Penetration Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), INDESTRUCTIBLE (This defense cannot be BREACHED.)
armor.desc: Most wards can be cracked, peeled, ground down until they fail. This seasoned working cannot — the field holds whole no matter how the attacker tries to pierce or shatter it, refusing the very idea of being breached. The protection on offer is moderate but absolutely durable, leaning into tech intrusion, a veil that wears down its enemies by simply outlasting their cleverness. It firms as the bearer's spirit rises and firms further at the height of their focus. The clever engineers of Berilia hate it on principle, since 'unbreakable' offends their love of a clever exploit. It will not make you untouchable. It will make sure the wall is still standing when the dust clears, every time.

armor.name: Major Penetration Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), INDESTRUCTIBLE (This defense cannot be BREACHED.)
armor.desc: Other wards can be worn down, cracked, finally shattered. This one cannot be broken — not chipped, not breached, not ever, no matter how the blows pile up. Its raw strength is unflashy, a modest steady ward against the wires and little else, but it never fails and never falls, which over a long fight is its own kind of overwhelming. As the bearer's spirit wakes every guard climbs higher, reaching absurd heights at full flood. Sieges have been laid against a single wearer of this thing and ended in the besiegers going home. A masterwork of the old craft, passed along under the wry slogan that nothing lasts forever — except, apparently, this.

armor.name: Minor Chronophage Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), STASIS (As soon as you enter the DYING stage (from either MORALE, HEALTH or TRAUMA) you automatically stabilize. You will only die if you take further damage or traumas.)
armor.desc: A patient ward that feeds on stolen seconds, made to keep its bearer from quite finishing the act of dying. It blunts intrusion and tech reasonably and dulls blade and beam a little, but its quiet mercy is in the worst moment: as body, nerve, or spirit gives out and the bearer slips toward the end, the field clamps the wound shut and stabilizes them on its own. They will only truly die if something hits them again. The veil also firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Uncommon and moderately priced, beloved by field-medics and the recklessly mortal. It buys you a little more time — exactly the amount your enemies will try to take back.

armor.name: Intermediate Chronophage Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), STASIS (As soon as you enter the DYING stage (from either MORALE, HEALTH or TRAUMA) you automatically stabilize. You will only die if you take further damage or traumas.)
armor.desc: Named for the time-eater, this developed ward steals a moment back from the edge of the end. The instant the wearer would slip into dying — body broken, nerve shattered, or spirit guttering out — the field clamps the clock, stabilizing them on the threshold so that only fresh harm can finish what was started. The everyday veil is steady and tech-wary, but its true gift is that refusal to let the last second be the last. It firms as the keeper's spirit gathers and firms again at the crest of their focus. It does not heal you; it merely tells death to take a number. Death, in our experience, is bad at waiting.

armor.name: Major Chronophage Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), STASIS (As soon as you enter the DYING stage (from either MORALE, HEALTH or TRAUMA) you automatically stabilize. You will only die if you take further damage or traumas.)
armor.desc: It does not stop you from dying so much as refuse to let the moment finish. The instant the bearer crosses into the dark — body failing, will shattering, spirit guttering out — this ward devours that last tick of time and holds them fast at the threshold, stable, waiting, neither living well nor dying properly. Only fresh harm can push them past; left alone, they simply linger. Its everyday shielding is solid against the wires and lifts with the spirit as it wakes, climbing high at full power. Battlefield mystics call it the second chance you never agreed to ask for, which is the most honest gratitude anyone ever musters for the thing that wouldn't let them quit.

armor.name: Minor Measuring Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), SUPPRESSIVE (This defense has maximum SOAK value against any area damage where you are not the primary target.)
armor.desc: A canny field that knows the difference between a shot meant for you and a blast you merely happened to be near. It blunts intrusion and tech well enough and dulls blade and beam a touch, but against any wide, indiscriminate burst where you are not the chosen target, it holds at its absolute firmest. Bystanding, it turns out, is the one thing it does flawlessly. The veil also strengthens as its bearer's spirit stirs, stronger still at full focus. Rare and pricey, favored by those who keep finding themselves at the edge of other people's explosions. It will not save you from the bullet with your name on it — only from the dozen that weren't aiming.

armor.name: Intermediate Measuring Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), SUPPRESSIVE (This defense has maximum SOAK value against any area damage where you are not the primary target.)
armor.desc: This seasoned ward has a talent for not being the bullseye. When destruction blooms across an area and the wearer is merely caught in the spill rather than the mark, the field rises to its absolute fullness, treating the blast as a problem meant for somebody else. Against the focused strike it is a solid, tech-leaning veil; against the indiscriminate it is nearly contemptuous, absorbing the splash like rain off a coat. It firms as its bearer's spirit rises and firms further at the height of their focus. Demolition crews and crowd-control survivors prize it dearly. Stand near the explosion, not in it — the ward knows the difference, even when the explosion does not.

armor.name: Major Measuring Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), SUPPRESSIVE (This defense has maximum SOAK value against any area damage where you are not the primary target.)
armor.desc: Built for the soul who lives at the edge of other people's catastrophes. When fire blooms or shrapnel sprays and the bearer merely happens to be standing nearby — the blast meant for someone else, the storm they didn't start — this ward holds at its absolute best, absorbing the spillover as though it had been measured out and refused. Against a blow aimed squarely at them it is merely very good; against the world's collateral it is untouchable. Every guard lifts as the spirit wakes, vaulting high at full power. One of a kind, and beloved by exactly the sort of veteran who has learned that most of what kills you was never really about you.

armor.name: Minor Undoing Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), HACKPROOF (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against TECH attacks.)
armor.desc: A specialist's veil that pours all its conviction into the war against machines. Against intrusion, hostile code, and tech-strikes it always holds at its very firmest, a flat refusal that no hack can talk its way past. Against blade and beam it is merely present, doing the polite minimum. The field grows stronger as its bearer's spirit stirs, stronger still at the height of their focus. Rare and costly, prized by deckers and ghost-runners who fear the firewall far more than the fist. Spirit-tech turned against its silicon cousins, and quietly smug about it.

armor.name: Intermediate Undoing Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), HACKPROOF (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against TECH attacks.)
armor.desc: Every hostile program, every intrusion, every weaponized line of code that comes for the wearer meets this developed ward at its absolute fullness — the field gives its best against tech aggression, every time, no exceptions, no soft spots to probe. It is dependable to the point of insult, a veil that treats the slickest exploit like a knock on a vault. The broader protection leans hard into machine and signal warding, confident and unhurried. It firms as the keeper's spirit gathers and firms again at the peak of their focus. The deckers of Berilia have retired careers trying to crack one. The name fits: whatever the attacker built, this quietly undoes the having-built-it.

armor.name: Major Undoing Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), HACKPROOF (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against TECH attacks.)
armor.desc: The wires are full of things that want into your head, your gear, your nervous system — and this veil shuts every one of them out at its absolute best, every time, no luck involved. Hostile code, scrambling pulses, the cold logic of the hunter-program: all of it breaks against a ward that simply does not roll poorly against the machine. Its broader shielding is already deep and patient, and it lifts every guard as the bearer's spirit wakes, climbing remarkably high at full flood. One of a kind. The techno-mystics of Berilia built it to prove the old crafts could out-think the new ones, then refused, smugly, to explain how.

armor.name: Minor Phasing Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), PHASE (Phase you out of reality when attacked. Gain a 1 in 10 chance of negating any attack.)
armor.desc: A ward that answers a strike by briefly declining to exist. It guards modestly against intrusion and tech, lightly against blade, beam, and the occult, but now and then — about once in a handful of attempts — it simply ghosts the wearer out of the moment, and the blow lands on a person who is, for that instant, not there. Unreliable, untheatrical, and unsettling when it works. The veil also firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Uncommon, mid-priced, and faintly nauseating to phase through. You can't count on it; you can only be quietly grateful when reality blinks on your behalf.

armor.name: Intermediate Phasing Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), PHASE (Phase you out of reality when attacked. Gain a 1 in 10 chance of negating any attack.)
armor.desc: Now and then, when the strike should land, the wearer simply isn't quite real — this developed ward slips them a half-step out of the world, and the attack passes through the space they declined to occupy. The slip is not reliable, a roughly one-in-ten grace, but when it comes it negates the harm entirely, as if the blow had been aimed at a rumor. The standing veil leans toward tech intrusion with a thread of the spiritual, steady between the lucky vanishings. It firms as the bearer's spirit rises and firms again at the crest of their focus, the slips coming a touch more readily. You cannot summon the ghost-step on command. You can only enjoy it when reality politely loses track of you.

armor.name: Major Phasing Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), PHASE (Phase you out of reality when attacked. Gain a 1 in 10 chance of negating any attack.)
armor.desc: Now and then the universe takes a swing at the wearer of this thing and finds, mid-swing, that there is no one there. When attacked, the field briefly slides its bearer a half-step out of reality itself — and roughly one strike in ten simply passes through where a person used to be, negated entirely, as if the blow had been a bad dream. The rest of the time it offers a fair, thin ward and a faint occult shimmer. Every guard rises as the spirit wakes, soaring at full power. A maddening relic to fight: you can land nine perfect blows and still be left explaining, to no one, where the tenth went.

armor.name: Minor Balance Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.)
armor.desc: An even-handed ward with no favorites and no flair. It leans a touch toward the physical, turning aside blade and bludgeon a little better than most minor workings, while still keeping a hand raised against beam, intrusion, and the occult. There is no clever trick to it — just a calm, well-centered field that does a respectable amount of everything and a brilliant amount of nothing. The veil firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Common, affordable starter gear for adepts who haven't yet decided what they're afraid of. The sensible first ward, which is exactly why nobody brags about it.

armor.name: Intermediate Balance Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.)
armor.desc: No single weakness, no single strength — this seasoned ward spreads itself evenly, a veil that meets the fist a little better than the rest while keeping a steady eye on energy, machine, and the unseen alike. It is the all-rounder's working, favored by mystics who would rather be ready for anything than brilliant at one thing and naked to the others. The protection is honest and well-built, the kind of dependable that wins long fights. It firms as the keeper's spirit gathers and firms again at the peak of their focus, every facet rising together. There is an elegance to refusing to specialize. There is also the smug satisfaction of watching a specialist meet the one thing they didn't prepare for.

armor.name: Major Balance Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.)
armor.desc: The masterwork of mystics who distrusted clever tricks and built, instead, a thing that is simply good at everything. No single brilliant gimmick — just a deep, even ward that meets steel a touch more readily than the rest, and answers fire, wire, and the occult with the same unhurried competence. Where flashier relics gamble and dazzle, this one merely holds, on every front, all the time. As the bearer's spirit wakes each guard lifts together, climbing high at full power. A flagship working of the old balanced school, favored by those who have outlived their taste for surprises — which, on the frontier, is most of the ones still breathing.

armor.name: Minor Shaping Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), MASTERWORK (Critical hits have no additional effects. Masterwork has no effect if the wearer is BREACHED.)
armor.desc: A carefully wrought field that refuses to let a lucky blow become a catastrophe. It leans toward the physical, blunting blade and impact a little better than beam, intrusion, or the occult. Its craft shows when a strike lands true: where a clean hit might cripple or maim through lesser wards, this one strips away the extra cruelty and treats the wound as ordinary. The fineness fails, however, the moment the field itself is breached. The veil firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Uncommon and moderately priced, the work of an artisan who clearly took it personally. A small, elegant insistence that nothing be worse than it has to be.

armor.name: Intermediate Shaping Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), MASTERWORK (Critical hits have no additional effects. Masterwork has no effect if the wearer is BREACHED.)
armor.desc: A craftsman's ward, shaped rather than merely summoned, this developed working denies the killing flourish — when a blow lands with that extra savage twist meant to maim or cripple, the field flattens it to a plain, ordinary hit, stripping away the cruelty and leaving only the bruise. It favors the physical, a clean and steady veil that holds together with quiet pride. It firms as the bearer's spirit rises and firms again at the crest of their focus. The fine print is fair: should the field itself be breached, the flourish-eating goes with it. The armorers of Berilia sign their best ones. Critical hits still hurt. They just stop showing off.

armor.name: Major Shaping Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), MASTERWORK (Critical hits have no additional effects. Masterwork has no effect if the wearer is BREACHED.)
armor.desc: Critical blows are how most armor dies — the lucky strike that finds the seam and turns a scratch into a catastrophe. This masterwork refuses the premise: a perfect hit lands as merely a hit, its cruel little bonus effects sheared cleanly off, so long as the ward still stands. It holds firmly across the board, a touch keener against the physical, and asks only that you not let it be broken first, after which all bets are off. Every guard rises as the spirit wakes, vaulting high at full power. The artisans who shaped it signed their work; collectors pay extra for the signature and more still for the smug.

armor.name: Minor Ironskin Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), HARDENED (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against PHYSICAL attacks.)
armor.desc: A blunt, honest ward for people who get hit with solid objects. Against blade, fist, and shrapnel it always holds at its very firmest — no flinching, no flutter, just a flat refusal to let the physical world have its way. It leans toward the body, doing only the courteous minimum against beam, intrusion, and the occult. The field strengthens as its bearer's spirit stirs, stronger still at full focus. Uncommon, modestly priced, and refreshingly free of mystique. Brawlers and bouncers swear by it; it asks nothing of you but to keep standing there and let the hits be disappointing.

armor.name: Intermediate Ironskin Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), HARDENED (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against PHYSICAL attacks.)
armor.desc: Against anything physical — blade, fist, slug, falling girder — this seasoned ward gives its absolute fullness every single time, the field hardening over the skin like a second hide that simply does not flinch. It is the brawler's working: unsubtle, dependable, leaning hard into the body's guard, a veil that meets violence with a shrug it has perfected. It firms as the keeper's spirit gathers and firms again at the height of their focus, the hide growing thicker still. Energy and the occult get the ordinary treatment, but no one buys this for nuance. They buy it because punches stop being interesting. Hit it as hard as you like. The ward has felt worse, and recently.

armor.name: Major Ironskin Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), HARDENED (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against PHYSICAL attacks.)
armor.desc: Against anything with mass and malice behind it — the fist, the blade, the slug, the falling wall — this ward holds at its absolute best, every single time, no roll left to chance. Physical violence simply meets the maximum and stops there, predictable as gravity and twice as patient. Its guard against fire and the occult is modest by comparison; it knows what it is for and refuses to pretend otherwise. As the bearer's spirit wakes every guard climbs higher, reaching absurd heights at full flood. Brawlers and bodyguards across Alliance Space speak of it in the reverent, slightly bored tone of people who have stopped worrying about getting hit.

armor.name: Minor Regeneration Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), HEALING (During MAINTENANCE you can spend any number of NANITES, or personal CHI to recover an equal amount of HEALTH or MORALE)
armor.desc: A nurturing veil that does as much mending as warding. It leans toward the physical, blunting blade and impact a little better than the rest, but its real worth comes in the quiet between fights: in those still moments the bearer may pour in healing-nanites or a measure of their own inner reserve and draw back an equal portion of body or spirit. The field also firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Rare and costly, favored by long-haul mystics who'd rather not bleed out waiting for a medic. It will not patch you for free — but it makes every drop you spend on yourself actually count.

armor.name: Intermediate Regeneration Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), HEALING (During MAINTENANCE you can spend any number of NANITES, or personal CHI to recover an equal amount of HEALTH or MORALE)
armor.desc: This developed ward turns the lull between fights into a quiet workshop of repair — during a moment's maintenance the bearer can pour out nanites or their own inner reserve and draw back an equal measure of mended flesh or steadied nerve. The standing veil is solid and physical-leaning, a confident wall, but its real charm is the slow knitting-shut that follows the worst of the day. It firms as the bearer's spirit rises and firms again at the peak of their focus. The exchange is literal: spend to mend, nothing for free. Field medics adore it for the simple reason that it lets a body buy back what the day took, in cash and spirit both.

armor.name: Major Regeneration Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), HEALING (During MAINTENANCE you can spend any number of NANITES, or personal CHI to recover an equal amount of HEALTH or MORALE)
armor.desc: A ward that does not merely endure but quietly repays the debt. In the still moments between violence, the bearer may pour in nanites or their own inner reserve and draw back an equal measure of mended flesh or steadied spirit — a slow, deliberate alchemy of trading what you have for what you've lost. Its everyday shielding is deep and balanced, keenest against the physical, lifting every guard as the spirit wakes and soaring at full power. One of a kind, grown rather than built, and faintly warm to the touch. Field-menders adore it; the bean-counters who priced it have never fully recovered.

armor.name: Minor Thumping Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), KINETIC (If you CHARGE during any round where this defense was hit by a PHYSICAL attack you apply the attack you received to the recipient of the charge (if you receive multiple attacks, only apply the last one).)
armor.desc: A spiteful little field that remembers who hit it. It leans toward the physical, dulling blade and impact a touch better than beam, intrusion, or the occult, but its temper shows when the wearer charges: any solid blow it absorbed that round is handed straight to whoever they crash into. The veil holds a grudge and a momentum at once. It also firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Uncommon, modestly priced, and popular with adepts who consider taking a hit merely the first step of returning it. Strike the bearer, then watch them go give it to someone else with interest.

armor.name: Intermediate Thumping Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), KINETIC (If you CHARGE during any round where this defense was hit by a PHYSICAL attack you apply the attack you received to the recipient of the charge (if you receive multiple attacks, only apply the last one).)
armor.desc: This seasoned ward keeps the receipt. When a physical blow lands on the field and the wearer answers with a charge in the same breath, the harm they absorbed is handed straight to whatever they slam into — the last hit they ate becomes the first hit their target eats. The standing veil leans into the body's guard, sturdy and unbothered, content to drink the blow so it has something to repay. It firms as the keeper's spirit gathers and firms again at the height of their focus. Take many blows before charging and only the freshest gets forwarded; the ward is a courier, not a warehouse. Hit the wearer. The wearer, with great enthusiasm, will hit you back with it.

armor.name: Major Thumping Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), KINETIC (If you CHARGE during any round where this defense was hit by a PHYSICAL attack you apply the attack you received to the recipient of the charge (if you receive multiple attacks, only apply the last one).)
armor.desc: This ward keeps a tally, and the bearer settles it in person. Take a physical blow while wrapped in its field, then charge — and the very harm you absorbed is delivered, whole, into whatever you crash into, as though the field had merely been holding your enemy's attack in trust until you found a better recipient. Its protection is deep and even, a touch keener against the physical, climbing with the spirit as it wakes and vaulting high at full power. There is a particular look on a striker's face the instant their own blow comes back through someone else's shoulder. Connoisseurs of that look pay a fortune for this thing.

armor.name: Minor Genesis Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), HEALTHY (While this DEFENSE is active your life recovery from any source is doubled.)
armor.desc: A vital, green-tinged ward that keeps the bearer knitting back together faster than they ought to. It leans toward the physical, blunting blade and impact a little better than beam, intrusion, or the occult. Its true gift is in recovery: while the field is up, every drop of healing the bearer receives, from any source, counts double, so wounds close and strength returns at an almost unseemly pace. The veil also firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Rare and dear, prized by those who plan on being hurt and intend to get over it quickly. It doesn't stop the harm — it just refuses to let the harm stick around.

armor.name: Intermediate Genesis Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), HEALTHY (While this DEFENSE is active your life recovery from any source is doubled.)
armor.desc: Life clings harder under this developed ward — while the field is up, every drop of recovery the bearer earns from any source arrives doubled, wounds closing and strength returning at a pace that feels almost rude. The standing veil is a solid, physical-leaning wall, but its gift is the relentless thrum of renewal underneath, a body that refuses to stay spent. It firms as the bearer's spirit rises and firms again at the crest of their focus. The healers of Berilia pair it with their own work and watch patients sit up early, complaining. Genesis means beginning, and this ward keeps insisting on one. It will not raise the dead. It is, however, deeply opposed to letting you join them.

armor.name: Major Genesis Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), HEALTHY (While this DEFENSE is active your life recovery from any source is doubled.)
armor.desc: Life clings harder inside this field. While it burns, every trickle of recovery the bearer receives — salve, spell, slow stubborn knitting of the body — arrives doubled, as though the ward were quietly arguing with death about the terms. Its shielding is broad and deep, keenest against the physical, rising with the spirit as it wakes and soaring at full power. Wear it long enough and wounds that should linger simply lose interest. One of a kind, and the sort of relic medics whisper about on the frontier, where the difference between mending and not is usually just whether the universe could be bothered — this thing bothers.

armor.name: Minor Slamming Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), BUNKER (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when not moving. (Bonus applies during maintenance phase after a full round of no movement).)
armor.desc: A ward that rewards patience and punishes fidgeting. It leans toward the physical, dulling blade and impact a touch better than beam, intrusion, or the occult — but plant your feet and stop moving, and it locks down to its absolute firmest, a wall content to simply stand its ground. The longer you hold still, the more immovable you become. The veil also firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Uncommon, moderately priced, and beloved by sentries, snipers, and anyone defending a doorway. Stay put and it's a bunker; run and it's merely a coat.

armor.name: Intermediate Slamming Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), BUNKER (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when not moving. (Bonus applies during maintenance phase after a full round of no movement).)
armor.desc: Plant your feet and this seasoned ward becomes a fortress — hold still through a full round and the field settles to its absolute fullness, every part of the bearer's guard locked at its best while they refuse to budge. It rewards patience and punishes the jittery: a veil that leans into the body's protection and turns stillness into a wall worth hiding behind. It firms as the keeper's spirit gathers and firms again at the peak of their focus, the dug-in stance growing only more obstinate. Move and you trade the bunker for an ordinary good ward. Snipers and last-standers love it. Run, and it forgives you; it simply stops being a bunker the moment you do.

armor.name: Major Slamming Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), BUNKER (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when not moving. (Bonus applies during maintenance phase after a full round of no movement).)
armor.desc: Stand your ground and this ward becomes a fortress that grew where you planted your feet. Hold still — truly still, through a full round of stubborn refusal to budge — and it holds at its absolute best, every measure of protection maximal, a bunker of pure resolve. Move, and it relaxes to a still-formidable guard, deep across the board and keenest against the physical. Every guard rises as the spirit wakes, vaulting high at full power. It is the patient warrior's masterwork, the choice of those who have learned that the most dangerous thing on a battlefield is sometimes the one person who simply will not move.

armor.name: Minor Partenogenesis Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), ENERGIZING (You have maximum SOAK value against HEALTH attacks)
armor.desc: A life-tending veil that simply refuses to let your body be ground down. It leans toward the physical, blunting blade and impact a little better than the rest, but its certainty is reserved for assaults on the flesh itself — poison, decay, anything aimed at your vitality is met at its very firmest, every time. The field also strengthens as its bearer's spirit stirs, stronger still at full focus. Rare and costly, the work of healer-mystics who treat the wearer's stamina as something to be defended rather than spent. It won't keep you from being struck, but it will keep the struggle from hollowing you out.

armor.name: Intermediate Partenogenesis Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), ENERGIZING (You have maximum SOAK value against HEALTH attacks)
armor.desc: Whatever reaches for the bearer's vitality — poison, draining touch, the slow theft of strength from the flesh itself — meets this developed ward at its absolute fullness, every time, the field guarding the body's life-spark like a thing it grew on purpose. The standing veil is sturdy and physical-leaning, but its devotion is to keeping the wearer's vigor exactly where it belongs: inside them. It firms as the bearer's spirit rises and firms again at the height of their focus. The name speaks of life made from itself, and that is the promise — your own, undiminished, against everything that would siphon it. Bleed somebody else. This one is full, and intends to stay that way.

armor.name: Major Partenogenesis Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), ENERGIZING (You have maximum SOAK value against HEALTH attacks)
armor.desc: Some attacks bypass armor entirely and reach straight for the meat — poison, plague, the slow rot, the assault on the body's own machinery. Against all of it, this ward holds at its absolute best, every time, the flesh defended to the maximum as a matter of settled law. Its broader shielding is deep and even, a touch keener against the physical, climbing with the spirit as it wakes and soaring at full power. It is named for life that needs no second to make more of itself, and it guards the body with that same self-sufficient stubbornness. One of a kind, grown in a vat no one will admit to owning.

armor.name: Minor Alchemy Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), AEGIS (Special modifiers to damage or power (DEADLY, DP, AS, AR and EMP etc) have no effect Vs this armor. Treat all damage at its base value.)
armor.desc: A leveling field that strips the cruelty out of clever weapons. It leans toward energy, turning aside pulse and plasma a little better than blade, intrusion, or the occult. Its quiet genius is in refusal: all the nasty enhancements that make a weapon worse than it should be — armor-shredding, deadliness, the disruptive ones, every fancy modifier — simply don't take, and the harm arrives plain and unembellished. The veil also firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Common and affordable, prized by adepts who'd rather face an honest hit than a gimmicked one. It can't make the world gentle, but it can make it stop showing off.

armor.name: Intermediate Alchemy Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), AEGIS (Special modifiers to damage or power (DEADLY, DP, AS, AR and EMP etc) have no effect Vs this armor. Treat all damage at its base value.)
armor.desc: Clever ammunition means nothing to this seasoned ward. Every cruel modifier an attacker layers on — armor-shredding tricks, lethality flourishes, the field-frying jolts meant to bypass protection — is simply ignored, the field treating each strike at its plain base value as though the gunsmith never bothered. It leans toward warding off energy, a calm and confident veil that finds gimmicks tedious. It firms as the keeper's spirit gathers and firms again at the crest of their focus. The alchemists of Berilia built it to transmute the exotic into the ordinary, which is exactly what it does to your enemy's expensive loadout. All that engineering, reduced to a regular hit. The ward is not impressed, and says so.

armor.name: Major Alchemy Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), AEGIS (Special modifiers to damage or power (DEADLY, DP, AS, AR and EMP etc) have no effect Vs this armor. Treat all damage at its base value.)
armor.desc: The cruelest weapons in Alliance Space are the ones with a clever modifier bolted on — armor-shredders, soul-burners, the pulse that fries the wires, the rounds bred to do more than merely hurt. This ward strips every one of those tricks away and treats the attack as the plain, base thing it pretended not to be, refusing to acknowledge the upgrade at all. It holds deep and even, keenest against raw energy, lifting every guard as the spirit wakes and soaring at full power. Alchemists named it well: it transmutes the exotic into the ordinary, then shrugs at the ordinary. The most expensive shrug money can buy.

armor.name: Minor Element-Fu Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), DUELIST (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against MELEE attacks.)
armor.desc: A close-quarters ward for mystics who keep the fight within arm's reach. It leans toward energy, blunting pulse and plasma a touch better than blade, intrusion, or the occult, but against anything swung at melee distance it always holds at its very firmest. Up close it is flawless; at range it remembers it has other things to do. The veil also strengthens as its bearer's spirit stirs, stronger still at full focus. Uncommon and moderately priced, favored by blade-dancers and brawling adepts who treat personal space as a kill-box. Let them in and you've made their weapon a polite suggestion.

armor.name: Intermediate Element-Fu Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), DUELIST (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against MELEE attacks.)
armor.desc: Step into close quarters and this developed ward comes alive — against any blow struck at melee range it gives its absolute fullness, every time, turning a knife-fight into an exercise in the attacker's growing frustration. The field has the grace of a martial form, energy-leaning and flowing, treating each near strike as a gesture it has already answered. It firms as the bearer's spirit rises and firms again at the peak of their focus, the dance only getting tighter. Ranged threats get the ordinary veil; the up-close brawler gets the full lesson. Frontier monks favor it for the obvious reason. Come close. It would genuinely love for you to come close.

armor.name: Major Element-Fu Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), DUELIST (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against MELEE attacks.)
armor.desc: Step into reach of this ward with a blade and you have made a small, fatal scheduling error. Against anything wielded in close — sword, claw, baton, bare knuckle — it holds at its absolute best, every time, the field meeting steel at the maximum as though it had trained for melee its whole life. Its guard against ranged fire is fair; against the occult and the physical, even. Keenest of all against raw energy, it lifts every guard as the spirit wakes and soars at full power. Dueling mystics across the frontier wear it like a quiet dare, and the smarter killers learn to fight them from very far away.

armor.name: Minor Conductivity Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), INSULATING (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against ENERGY attacks.)
armor.desc: A specialist's veil that drinks the sting out of every beam and bolt. Against pulse, plasma, flame, and shock it always holds at its very firmest, shrugging off energy where lesser wards merely smolder. It leans, naturally, toward the energetic, doing only the modest minimum against blade, intrusion, and the occult. The field strengthens as its bearer's spirit stirs, stronger still at full focus. Common and affordable, standard issue for anyone expecting to walk into a firefight rather than a knife-fight. Bring a blade and it shrugs; bring a beam and it positively yawns.

armor.name: Intermediate Conductivity Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), INSULATING (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against ENERGY attacks.)
armor.desc: Fire, frost, current, blast, the searing breath of weapons that burn rather than bite — against all of it this seasoned ward gives its absolute fullness, every time, the field grounding and scattering raw energy before it can take hold. It leans hard into warding off energy, an insulating veil that treats a plasma bolt the way a thick coat treats a cold draft. It firms as the keeper's spirit gathers and firms again at the height of their focus, the dampening only deepening. The physical and the occult get the ordinary treatment, but heat and charge get nothing at all. There are lesser versions sold to people who play with fire. This one lets you mean it.

armor.name: Major Conductivity Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), INSULATING (Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against ENERGY attacks.)
armor.desc: Fire, lightning, plasma, the searing breath of an energy lance — against all of it this ward holds at its absolute best, every single time, no luck involved. Raw energy simply meets the maximum and dissipates, grounded out into the field as though it had nowhere worth going. Its shielding against the physical and the occult is fair and steady; it knows its calling and answers it perfectly. As the bearer's spirit wakes every guard climbs higher, reaching absurd heights at full flood. Wear it into a firefight and the searing things wash over you like weather you forgot to dress for. A masterwork the energy-gunners have learned, grudgingly, to respect.

armor.name: Minor Resonance Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), ADAPTIVE (ADAPTIVE raises your defense to HIGH against any the last type of damage you were attacked by.)
armor.desc: A learning field that studies whatever just hurt you and braces for more of it. It leans toward energy, blunting pulse and plasma a little better than the rest at rest — but the instant a particular kind of harm lands, the veil rallies hard against that exact threat, holding stout the next time it comes. It is always one beat behind and one beat smarter. The field also firms as its bearer's spirit stirs, firmer still at full focus. Rare and costly, the work of adaptive mystics who'd rather adjust than predict. The first hit teaches it; the second hit regrets it.

armor.name: Intermediate Resonance Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), ADAPTIVE (ADAPTIVE raises your defense to HIGH against any the last type of damage you were attacked by.)
armor.desc: This developed ward learns the song of whatever just hit it. After a strike, the field tunes itself to that exact kind of harm and raises its guard against it to a formidable pitch, so the second blow of a sort fares far worse than the first. It leans toward warding off energy at rest, a responsive veil that treats every attacker as a teacher it intends to outgrow. It firms as the bearer's spirit gathers and firms again at the crest of their focus, the adaptation sharpening alongside. Hit it once and you've shown it your hand. Hit it the same way twice and you'll wonder why it suddenly stopped working — the ward was listening, and it has very good ears.

armor.name: Major Resonance Barrier
armor.special_desc: BARRIER (BARRIERS increase all DEFENSES by 1 category when SPIRIT MANIFESTATION is AWAKENED or 2 when EMPOWERED.), ADAPTIVE (ADAPTIVE raises your defense to HIGH against any the last type of damage you were attacked by.)
armor.desc: It learns. Whatever last struck the bearer — flame, fist, wire, or worse — this ward instantly tunes itself to a towering guard against precisely that, as though the attack had foolishly handed over its own instruction manual. Hit it with fire and the next fire finds a wall; switch to steel and it has already moved on, raising itself to meet you there instead. Its baseline is deep and even, keenest against raw energy, lifting every guard as the spirit wakes and soaring at full power. One of a kind, and a nightmare to fight by repetition — the only way through is novelty, and most killers run out of new ideas long before it runs out of answers.

armor_options.name: Spotlights

armor_options.name: Explorer package armor

armor_options.name: Explorer package forcefield

armor_options.name: Explorer package datacom

armor_options.name: Tactical Visor

armor_options.name: Time Dilation
armor_options.desc: When someone enters MELEE range with you time slows down, you and anyone within your melee range is SLOW. Increase FORCEFIELD DEFENSE to HIGH and gain DUELIST against any melee attacker that is SLOW.

armor_options.name: Maintenance mode
armor_options.desc: Device has built in basic tools required to maintain and repair the device. Removes the need for external tools.

armor_options.name: Trauma unit

armor_options.name: Anti-Papparazzi
armor_options.desc: Your DISCRETE option now grants 10 CONCEALMENT vs Type II devices (Electronic surveillance).

armor_options.name: Auto-Purge
armor_options.desc: Removes any ongoing damage AILMENTS at the end of the maintenance phase if you have not saved against them already.

armor_options.name: Combat tracker
armor_options.desc: Gain a SMALL bonus to all DEFENSES ATTRIBUTES against any target you have LOCK-ON against.

armor_options.name: Cosmetic Package
armor_options.desc: Allows the device to display any design, texture or logo of your choice. Grants a SMALL bonus if used as part of a disguise.

armor_options.name: Sound Dampeners

armor_options.name: Drone-Controller
armor_options.desc: Provides 1 CPU but usage is limited for DRONE use only.

armor_options.name: EMP shielded
armor_options.desc: Device is protected from ELECTRO MAGNETIC PULSE (EMP). This does not prevent damage.

armor_options.name: Frangible Plating
armor_options.desc: Grants protection against AR for up to a SCENE but is destroyed after any SCENE where it prevented an AR modifier.

armor_options.name: Gravity controller
armor_options.desc: Device now provides artificial gravity for yourself. You can ignore gravity related difficult terrain.

armor_options.name: Lock-on Jammer
armor_options.desc: CYBERINTEL LOCK-ON attacks against you have a LARGE penalty.

armor_options.name: Luxury Package
armor_options.desc: Item is custom made to be as luxurious as possible is now a LUXURY item and it's design is UNIQUE.

armor_options.name: Memory Bank
armor_options.desc: This item has 3 units of MEMORY storage, this storage has CONCEALMENT 5 vs Type 1 and Type 2 surveillance.

armor_options.name: Repair bots

armor_options.name: Nano-Reserves

armor_options.name: Overcharge
armor_options.desc: While your FORCEFIELD is recharging any ENERGY attacks you make have its POWER level increased by 1.

armor_options.name: Security Package
armor_options.desc: When outside of a NETWORK this device now has a SYSTEM rating of 5 instead of the default 1.

armor_options.name: Spirit Guard
armor_options.desc: When your defenses are not BREACHED, attempts to bind your SPIRIT receives a LARGE penalty.

armor_options.name: Suit-Up!
armor_options.desc: If applied to a LIGHT ARMOR, you can now put it on as a STANDARD action. If applied to a MEDIUM or HEAVY ARMOR, you instead reduce the time to put them on to 1 round and 2 rounds respectivelly.

armor_options.name: Supercharger
armor_options.desc: If both your forcefield and energy weapon have this option, as a QUICK action you can set one non recharging item to recharge to instantly recharge the other one. Both items must have the same recharge time for this to work.

armor_options.name: Tach-Field
armor_options.desc: Item gains the DISCRETE special modifier but the CONCEALMENT is only 1.

armor_options.name: Professional Calibration

armor_options.name: Barrel Mount
armor_options.desc: Allows the weapon to attach small non-combat tools like a flashlight. Inceases weapon size by 1.

armor_options.name: Bayonet
armor_options.desc: Your weapon can produce a KNIFE on demand, paramaters are the same as a regular KNIFE except that the KNIFE damage type will match your WEAPONS base damage type as well. This allows your weapon to be used in MELEE without any penalties.

armor_options.name: Combat grip
armor_options.desc: This DEVICE can be used in melee. Counts as a nightstick if the device is SMALL or MEDIUM and a STAFF if it is LARGER. TINY DEVICES cannot have this option.

armor_options.name: Deflection Field
armor_options.desc: Weapon has a deflection field to help against attacks. Grants a frontal only MEDIUM DEFENSE against all damage types while wielding this weapon.

armor_options.name: Compact Folding
armor_options.desc: Weapon can be compacted (reduce size by 1 category but unusable until expanded). Takes a Quick action to change from compact to full.

armor_options.name: Full Stabilizer
armor_options.desc: Your EXPERTISE roll is LUCKY when using FULL AUTO. Weapon size increase by 1

armor_options.name: Grav compensator
armor_options.desc: Removes the BULKY and RECOIL modifier from a weapon. EXPERTISE is reduced by 3.

armor_options.name: Extended magazine
armor_options.desc: Doubles weapon ammo capacity but increase weapon size class by 1.

armor_options.name: Long barrel
armor_options.desc: Increase WEAPON range to maximum in category. Increase weapon size class by 1.

armor_options.name: Reinforced
armor_options.desc: DEVICE gains the DUR+ special option and EXPERTISE can never drop under 0 (No effect if no EXPERTISE or already under 0)

armor_options.name: Short barrel
armor_options.desc: Reduce WEAPON size by 1 category but LONG RANGE is no longer possible and MEDIUM range has a LARGE penalty to hitl.

armor_options.name: Ammo Selector
armor_options.desc: Munition based weapon can select different kind of ammunitions from the same magazine as a free action.

armor_options.name: Singularity generator
armor_options.desc: Radius of EXPLOSIVE weapons can now exclude one 1x1m area from blast radius.

armor_options.name: Fast Charge Cells
armor_options.desc: Once per SCENE you can bypass your DEVICE RECHARGE time. Doing so instantly recharges the device but for the rest of the SCENE your SKILL/DEFENSE check with that DEVICE have their CRITICAL FAILURE treshold increases by 1.

armor_options.name: Virtual imaging
armor_options.desc: You ignore all visual penalities and type II CONCEALMENT. You are BLIND if your INTERNAL SYSTEM reaches 0.

armor_options.name: Heavy Coils
armor_options.desc: Your ENERGY weapon gains the DP tag but not longer shoots above MEDIUM RANGE range and ammo consumption is DOUBLED.

armor_options.name: Guidance system
armor_options.desc: You can add SMART to any munition based weapon attacks by consuming 3x the normal AMMO.

armor_options.name: Multi-Dimention Coils
armor_options.desc: Your ENERGY weapon fire gains the INV tag or INV+ if it already had INV. Expertise is reduced by 3 points.

armor_options.name: Assasination marker
armor_options.desc: When making PRECISION HITS your CRITICAL range increase by 1. Increases by 2 if you also have LOCK-ON. Weapon can no longer CRITICAL hit on non PRECISION HITS.

armor_options.name: Multi-Detonator
armor_options.desc: Allows user to set exact detonation conditions for a SINGLE USE EXPLOSIVE based on almost anything. Explosive size increase to next category.

armor_options.name: Smart Detonation
armor_options.desc: Weapon will not fire or Explosive will not detonate if a friendly targets would be hit. Prevents all friendly fire.

armor_options.name: Speed reloader
armor_options.desc: You can reduce the reload time of AMMO based weapons by 1 action type (COMPLEX-STANDARD-QUICK). This cannot reduce reload under a quick action.

armor_options.name: Interface Implants
armor_options.desc: DEVICE now requires EVO Cybernetics to use. Gain a SMALL bonus to skill checks with that DEVICE if you activated a CYBERNETIC EVO this ROUND. Bonus increases to LARGE if the activation did not cost MORALE.

armor_options.name: Universal receiver
armor_options.desc: You can use any ammo as long as the category is equal or higher, you get no additional benefits from this.

armor_options.name: Auto-Fixit
armor_options.desc: In the case of a reliability malfunction (critical faillure) this DEVICE automatically fixes itself after 1 round.

armor_options.name: Biometric lock
armor_options.desc: DEVICE has a genetic lock and can only be used by owner or a perfect clone of the owner.

armor_options.name: Grenade attachment

armor_options.name: High Explosive
armor_options.desc: Increases EXPLOSIVE POWER to HIGH but reduces radius by half (Not usable if radius is reduced under 1m).

armor_options.name: Hypo Darts

armor_options.name: Laser Bayonet
armor_options.desc: ENERGY Weapon can now be used in MELEE with a SMALL penalty , damage and POWER remains the same but it does not trigger RETALIATION.

armor_options.name: Long range attachment
armor_options.desc: Eliminate LONG and MEDIUM range penalty when taking a PRECISION HIT action. Weapon size increase by 1 category.

armor_options.name: Serrated delivery

armor_options.name: Single Block accelerator

armor_options.name: Sticky coating

armor_options.name: Suppressor
armor_options.desc: Removes muzzle flash and lowers noise of PHYSICAL weapons. Gain INV tag when the distance exceeds 10m.

armor_options.name: Tactical computer
armor_options.desc: After hitting a target once you can perform QUICK action to lock-on vs that target (use your ranged roll instead of CYBERINTEL).

armor_options.name: Tripod attachment
armor_options.desc: Your weapon is considered BRACED if you have not moved this round. Weapon size increase by 1

armor_options.name: Charge capacitor
armor_options.desc: Your energy weapon no longer needs to charge before usage (start combat with full AMMO) but your RECHARGE time is doubled.
